text:
hannah: Hi team, first week here. Trying to consolidate observability for a cross-team flow (hosted + private inference). Specific blockers: 1) I can view Datadog dashboards but cannot create synthetic tests (403), 2) Grafana alerts appear but our folder lacks routing to the right slack channel, 3) Sentry project for the orchestration service not provisioned. Who owns synthetic test perms, folder routing, and Sentry provisioning?

ops-bot: Welcome @hannah! Typical next steps: join eng-observability, request Datadog `synthetics_write` or an API/app key, request Grafana folder tag/routing, open infra ticket for Sentry project using template `obs-cross-team`. Docs: https://redwood.internal/obs/cross-team-onboard :robot_face:

oscar: Hey @hannah 9 for Datadog synthetics you need `synthetics_write` and an API key with synthetics privileges. If you post the dashboard link I can check the team tag. Also we prefer creating synthetics under a shared app key and then rotating to a team key. Example minimal create for HTTP test (replace keys):

```curl -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/synthetics/tests" \
 -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY" \
 -H "DD-APPLICATION-KEY: $DD_APP_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"config":{"request":{"url":"https://hosted.redwood.internal/health","method":"GET"}},"locations":["aws:us-east-1"],"message":"@pagerduty cross-team synthetic","tags":["team:cross-inference"]}'```

If you want I can create a test under my app key for verification.

maria: For Grafana routing we map folder tags to slack channels and pager policies in infra config. If your folder has `team:cross-inference` tag I can wire routing; otherwise we need to add the tag or create a routing rule. Send me the dashboard UID (Dashboards -> Share -> Link -> uid=...).

hannah: Datadog dashboard: https://datadog.redwood.internal/dash/cross-9001/inference-flow; Grafana UID: `cT7Xq9Zk`.

oscar: I checked; you currently lack `synthetics_write`. I can spin up a temporary HTTP synthetic test and tag it `team:cross-inference` to validate routing. Shall I proceed?

hannah: Please, yes. Also, for Sentry: who do I put in the infra ticket? We need server DSN + performance settings (transaction sampling) enabled.

infra: Use template `obs-cross-team` and include: org email domain, desired slug (e.g., `cross-inference-hannah`), repo, envs, and required Sentry sampling rate. We can provision server DSN and enable transaction sampling; public DSN depends on policy. ETA ~3 business days unless expedited. Include `synthetics` in the ticket to request Datadog key provisioning.

maria: Hannah, folder `cross-inference` exists but lacks a `team:` tag. I can add `team:cross-inference` and create a routing rule to `#cross-inference-alerts` -> `pagerduty_cross_inference` escalation. Will do once infra confirms Sentry and Datadog keys.

oscar: Created a temporary synthetic test under my key tagged `team:cross-inference`. It ran and reported a ping to #cross-inference-alerts. Hannah, did you see the Datadog notification?

hannah: I saw the ping in #cross-inference-alerts, thanks!

maria: I added `team:cross-inference` tag to the Grafana folder and created routing; new alerts will route to the slack channel and pager after infra updates the routing config.

hannah: Opening infra ticket now. Filed OBS-5099 with slug `cross-inference-hannah`, requested synthetics key, Sentry server DSN, and transaction sampling 10%. Linked the Datadog dashboard and Grafana UID.

infra: OBS-5099 acknowledged. Missing field: repo path. Please update ticket. ETA ~72 hours. If you need a faster smoke test we can provide short-lived keys.

hannah: Updated OBS-5099 with repo. Also question: for Grafana embeds in the shared runbook, do we prefer signed iframe or snapshot? This will be used by on-call.

maria: For shared on-call runbooks we prefer signed iframe embeds with 1h TTL so on-call sees live data. Include Confluence page id in the ticket and we will issue a signed token. If the runbook is customer-facing, export a snapshot instead.

oscar: Note: after infra provisions the Datadog key, rotate any temp tests to use the team-scoped key and delete the temp test to avoid noise.

hannah: Great, thanks everyone. Will watch OBS-5099 and ping here when infra confirms. Appreciate the rapid help :heart:
